stage.note: No external funding round has been disclosed for Amp Frontier Corporation as an independent entity; the company describes itself as profitable rather than newly VC-funded. Its former parent Sourcegraph, Inc. had raised $223M across Series A-D (last: $125M Series D, July 2021, led by Andreessen Horowitz), but that capital and cap table belong to Sourcegraph, not confirmed to carry over to the spun-out Amp entity.

last_round.quote: Amp is becoming a separate company. We're spinning out of Sourcegraph to become an independent research lab.

note: Amp was originally an AI coding-agent product of Sourcegraph, Inc. (founded 2013 by Quinn Slack and Beyang Liu; raised $223M total, last round $125M Series D in July 2021 led by Andreessen Horowitz at a $2.625B valuation, per Wikipedia/Tracxn/TechCrunch). In December 2025 Sourcegraph announced Amp would spin out as its own independent company, 'Amp Frontier Corporation', citing Amp's commercial traction and profitability. No new external funding round for the spun-out entity has been found; figures above regarding funding/investors describe the former parent Sourcegraph, not Amp Frontier Corporation directly.
